Generate Class Diagram for
1.	User Profile Management:
o	Create, edit, and delete user profiles.
o	Upload and manage profile pictures.
o	Set privacy settings for profile information.
o	Search for other users.
2.	Friend Connections:
o	Send and receive friend requests.
o	Accept or decline friend requests.
o	View and manage friend lists.
o	Block and unblock users.
3.	News Feed:
o	View posts from friends and followed pages.
o	Like, comment, and share posts.
o	Sort posts by date or popularity.
o	Filter posts by category or keyword.
4.	Post Creation and Sharing:
o	Create text, image, and video posts.
o	Add location tags and hashtags to posts.
o	Schedule posts to be published at a later time.
o	Delete or edit existing posts.
5.	Messaging:
o	Send direct messages to friends.
o	Create group chats.
o	Send and receive multimedia messages (images, videos, audio).
o	Search for messages and conversations.
6.	Notifications:
o	Receive notifications for friend requests, messages, likes, comments, and shares.
o	Customize notification settings.
o	Mark notifications as read or unread.

```plantuml
@startuml
class UserProfile {
    - profileID : int
    - username : string
    - profilePicture : Image
    - privacySettings : PrivacySettings
    + createProfile()
    + editProfile()
    + deleteProfile()
    + uploadProfilePicture()
    + manageProfilePicture()
    + setPrivacySettings()
    + searchUsers(keyword : string) : List<UserProfile>
}

class FriendConnection {
    - connectionID : int
    - user1 : UserProfile
    - user2 : UserProfile
    - status : ConnectionStatus
    + sendFriendRequest()
    + acceptFriendRequest()
    + declineFriendRequest()
    + blockUser()
    + unblockUser()
}

class NewsFeed {
    - feedID : int
    - user : UserProfile
    + viewPosts()
    + likePost(post : Post)
    + commentOnPost(post : Post, comment : string)
    + sharePost(post : Post)
    + sortPosts(criteria : SortCriteria)
    + filterPosts(filter : Filter)
}

class Post {
    - postID : int
    - content : string
    - media : List<Media>
    - locationTag : Location
    - hashtags : List<string>
    - schedule : DateTime
    + createPost()
    + editPost()
    + deletePost()
    + addLocationTag()
    + addHashtags()
    + schedulePost()
}

class Message {
    - messageID : int
    - sender : UserProfile
    - recipients : List<UserProfile>
    - content : string
    - multimedia : List<Multimedia>
    + sendMessage()
    + searchMessages(keyword : string) : List<Message>
}


class Notification {
    - notificationID : int
    - user : UserProfile
    - type : NotificationType
    - content : string
    - status : NotificationStatus
    + sendNotification()
    + customizeNotificationSettings()
    + markAsRead()
    + markAsUnread()
}

enum ConnectionStatus {
    PENDING
    ACCEPTED
    DECLINED
    BLOCKED
}

enum SortCriteria {
    DATE
    POPULARITY
}

enum NotificationType {
    FRIEND_REQUEST
    MESSAGE
    LIKE
    COMMENT
    SHARE
}

enum NotificationStatus {
    READ
    UNREAD
}

UserProfile "1" *-- "*" FriendConnection
UserProfile "1" *-- "*" NewsFeed
UserProfile "1" -- "*" Post
UserProfile "1" *-- "*" Message
UserProfile "1" -- "*" Notification
Post *-- "*" Media
Message *-- "*" Multimedia


@enduml
```

Generate Sequence Diagram for
Manager:

Generate Reports: Create reports on hotel performance. Can include Occupancy Report or Revenue Report.

Manage Employees: Handle employee scheduling and other personnel tasks.

Manage Rooms: Oversee room availability and maintenance. Includes Update Room Availability and can optionally Close Room for Maintenance.

Manage Inventory: Track and manage hotel supplies.

Set Room Rates: Determine pricing for different room types.

Create Promotions: Develop special offers and discounts.

```plantuml
@startuml
actor Manager as manager
participant System as system
participant ReportService as report
participant EmployeeService as employee
participant RoomService as room
participant InventoryService as inventory
participant RateService as rate
participant PromotionService as promotion

alt Generate Reports
manager -> system: Generate Report (report type)
activate system
alt Occupancy Report
    system -> report: Generate Occupancy Report
    activate report
    report --> system: Occupancy Report
    deactivate report
else Revenue Report
    system -> report: Generate Revenue Report
    activate report
    report --> system: Revenue Report
    deactivate report
end
system --> manager: Display Report
deactivate system
end

alt Manage Employees
manager -> system: Manage Employees (action, details)
activate system
system -> employee: Process Employee Action
activate employee
employee --> system: Confirmation
deactivate employee
system --> manager: Action Completed
deactivate system
end

alt Manage Rooms
manager -> system: Manage Rooms (room number, action)
activate system
alt Update Availability
    system -> room: Update Room Availability
    activate room
    room --> system: Availability Updated
    deactivate room
else Close for Maintenance
    system -> room: Close Room for Maintenance
    activate room
    room --> system: Room Closed
    deactivate room
end
system --> manager: Action Completed
deactivate system
end

alt Manage Inventory
manager -> system: Manage Inventory (action, details)
activate system
system -> inventory: Process Inventory Action
activate inventory
inventory --> system: Confirmation
deactivate inventory
system --> manager: Action Completed
deactivate system
end

alt Set Room Rates
manager -> system: Set Room Rates (room type, rate)
activate system
system -> rate: Update Room Rates
activate rate
rate --> system: Rates Updated
deactivate rate
system --> manager: Rates Updated
deactivate system
end

alt Create Promotions
manager -> system: Create Promotion (promotion details)
activate system
system -> promotion: Create Promotion
activate promotion
promotion --> system: Promotion Created
deactivate promotion
system --> manager: Promotion Created
deactivate system
end

@enduml
```

Generate Sequence Diagram
Receptionist:

Check In Guest: Register a guest's arrival. Includes Verify Guest Information.

Check Out Guest: Process a guest's departure. Includes Calculate Bill and may optionally handle Process Late Checkout.

Manage Bookings: Handle booking requests and modifications.

Handle Guest Inquiries: Respond to guest questions and requests.

Process Payments: Accept payments from guests.

```plantuml
@startuml

actor Receptionist as receptionist
participant System as system
participant BookingService as booking
participant RoomService as room
participant PaymentService as payment
participant InquiryService as inquiry


alt Check In Guest
receptionist -> system: Check In Guest (booking ID)
activate system
system -> booking: Retrieve Booking
activate booking
booking --> system: Booking Details (guest info, room number)
deactivate booking
system -> room: Update Room Status (Occupied)
activate room
room --> system: Room Status Updated
deactivate room
system --> receptionist: Check-In Complete (room key, etc.)
deactivate system
end

alt Check Out Guest
receptionist -> system: Check Out Guest (room number)
activate system
system -> room: Get Room Details
activate room
room --> system: Room Details (guest info, check-in date)
deactivate room
system -> booking: Calculate Bill
activate booking
booking --> system: Bill Amount
deactivate booking
opt Process Late Checkout
    receptionist -> system: Request Late Checkout
    system -> booking: Process Late Checkout
    activate booking
    booking --> system: Adjusted Bill Amount
    deactivate booking
end
system --> receptionist: Bill Details
receptionist -> system: Payment Received
system -> payment: Process Payment
activate payment
payment --> system: Payment Confirmation
deactivate payment
system -> room: Update Room Status (Available)
activate room
room --> system: Room Status Updated
deactivate room
system --> receptionist: Check-Out Complete
deactivate system
end


alt Manage Bookings
receptionist -> system: Manage Bookings (booking ID, action)
activate system
alt Create Booking
    system -> booking: Create Booking (details)
    activate booking
    booking --> system: Booking Confirmation
    deactivate booking
    system --> receptionist: Booking Created
else Modify Booking
    system -> booking: Modify Booking (details)
    activate booking
    booking --> system: Booking Modified
    deactivate booking
    system --> receptionist: Booking Modified
else Cancel Booking
    system -> booking: Cancel Booking (booking ID)
    activate booking
    booking --> system: Booking Cancelled
    deactivate booking
    system --> receptionist: Booking Cancelled
end
deactivate system
end


alt Handle Guest Inquiries
receptionist -> system: Handle Guest Inquiry (inquiry details)
activate system
system -> inquiry: Process Inquiry
activate inquiry
inquiry --> system: Inquiry Response
deactivate inquiry
system --> receptionist: Provide Response to Guest
deactivate system
end


alt Process Payments
receptionist -> system: Process Payment (payment details)
activate system
system -> payment: Process Payment
activate payment
payment --> system: Payment Confirmation
deactivate payment
system --> receptionist: Payment Processed
deactivate system
end


@enduml
```

Generate Sequence Diagram
Guest:

Search Rooms: Find available rooms based on criteria like dates and room type.

View Room Details: Get detailed information about a specific room.

Book Room: Reserve a selected room. Includes Check Room Availability and may optionally Request Special Amenities.

Manage Booking: Modify or cancel an existing booking. Can include Cancel Booking or Modify Booking.

Make Payment: Pay for a booking or other services. May optionally Apply Discount.

View Booking History: Review past bookings.

Write Review: Submit feedback about their stay.

```plantuml
@startuml

actor Guest as guest
participant System as system
participant RoomService as room
participant BookingService as booking
participant PaymentService as payment
participant ReviewService as review

alt Search Rooms
guest -> system: Search Rooms (dates, room type)
activate system
system -> room: Get Available Rooms
activate room
room --> system: Available Rooms
deactivate room
system --> guest: Display Available Rooms
deactivate system
end

alt View Room Details
guest -> system: View Room Details (room ID)
activate system
system -> room: Get Room Details
activate room
room --> system: Room Details
deactivate room
system --> guest: Display Room Details
deactivate system
end

alt Book Room
guest -> system: Book Room (room ID, dates)
activate system
system -> room: Check Availability
activate room
room --> system: Availability Confirmation
deactivate room
alt Available
    system -> booking: Create Booking
    activate booking
    booking --> system: Booking ID
    deactivate booking
    opt Request Special Amenities
        guest -> system: Request Amenities (amenities list)
        system -> booking: Add Amenities to Booking
        activate booking
        booking --> system: Confirmation
        deactivate booking
    end
    system --> guest: Booking Confirmation (Booking ID)
else Not Available
    system --> guest: Room Not Available
end
deactivate system
end

alt Manage Booking
guest -> system: Manage Booking (booking ID)
activate system
system -> booking: Retrieve Booking
activate booking
booking --> system: Booking Details
deactivate booking
system --> guest: Display Booking Details
alt Modify Booking
    guest -> system: Modify Booking (new details)
    system -> booking: Update Booking
    activate booking
    booking --> system: Confirmation
    deactivate booking
    system --> guest: Booking Modified
else Cancel Booking
    guest -> system: Cancel Booking
    system -> booking: Cancel Booking
    activate booking
    booking --> system: Confirmation
    deactivate booking
    system --> guest: Booking Cancelled
end
deactivate system
end


alt Make Payment
guest -> system: Make Payment (booking ID, amount)
activate system
opt Apply Discount
    guest -> system: Apply Discount (discount code)
    system -> payment: Validate Discount
    activate payment
    payment --> system: Discount Validated
    deactivate payment
end
system -> payment: Process Payment
activate payment
payment --> system: Payment Confirmation
deactivate payment
system --> guest: Payment Successful
deactivate system
end

alt View Booking History
guest -> system: View Booking History
activate system
system -> booking: Get Booking History
activate booking
booking --> system: Booking History
deactivate booking
system --> guest: Display Booking History
deactivate system
end

alt Write Review
guest -> system: Write Review (booking ID, rating, comments)
activate system
system -> review: Save Review
activate review
review --> system: Confirmation
deactivate review
system --> guest: Review Submitted
deactivate system
end



@enduml
```

Generate ER Diagram
Entities and Relationships

1. Users

UserID (Primary Key)
Username
Password
Email
Role (Student, Teacher, Admin)
2. Courses

CourseID (Primary Key)
CourseName
CourseDescription
InstructorID (Foreign Key to Users)
3. Assignments

AssignmentID (Primary Key)
CourseID (Foreign Key to Courses)
AssignmentName
DueDate
Description
4. Submissions

SubmissionID (Primary Key)
AssignmentID (Foreign Key to Assignments)
UserID (Foreign Key to Users)
SubmissionDate
SubmittedFile
5. Grades

GradeID (Primary Key)
SubmissionID (Foreign Key to Submissions)
Grade
Feedback
Relationships:

Users and Courses: A user can be enrolled in multiple courses, and a course can have multiple students and one instructor. This is a many-to-many relationship, which can be implemented using a junction table called "CourseEnrollments".
Courses and Assignments: A course can have multiple assignments, and an assignment belongs to only one course. This is a one-to-many relationship.
Users and Submissions: A user can submit multiple assignments, and an assignment can be submitted by multiple users. This is a many-to-many relationship, implemented using the "Submissions" entity.
Submissions and Grades: A submission can have only one grade, and a grade is associated with one submission. This is a one-to-one relationship.

Generate Sequence Diagram
Student Registration and Login:

User visits the platform's homepage.
User clicks on the "Register" or "Login" button.
User enters required information (email, password, etc.).
System verifies the information and creates a new user account or logs in the existing user.
User is redirected to the dashboard or homepage.

```plantuml
@startuml

actor User as user
participant Browser as browser
participant "Authentication Service" as auth

user -> browser: Visits homepage
activate browser
browser --> user: Displays homepage
deactivate browser

alt Registration
    user -> browser: Clicks "Register"
    activate browser
    browser --> user: Displays registration form
    deactivate browser
    user -> browser: Enters registration details
    activate browser
    browser -> auth: Submits registration details
    activate auth
    auth -> auth: Verifies information & creates account
    auth --> browser: Returns registration success/failure
    deactivate auth
    alt Success
        browser --> user: Redirects to dashboard
    else Failure
        browser --> user: Displays error message
    end
    deactivate browser
else Login
    user -> browser: Clicks "Login"
    activate browser
    browser --> user: Displays login form
    deactivate browser
    user -> browser: Enters login credentials
    activate browser
    browser -> auth: Submits login credentials
    activate auth
    auth -> auth: Verifies credentials
    auth --> browser: Returns login success/failure
    deactivate auth
    alt Success
        browser --> user: Redirects to dashboard/homepage
    else Failure
        browser --> user: Displays error message
    end
    deactivate browser
end



@enduml

```

Generate Sequence Diagram
Course Enrollment:

User browses available courses.
User selects a course and clicks on the "Enroll" button.
System verifies user's eligibility and enrollment status.
User is enrolled in the course and added to the course roster.
User receives a confirmation email or notification.

```plantuml
@startuml

actor User as user
participant Browser as browser
participant "Course Service" as course_service
participant "Notification Service" as notification_service

user -> browser: Browses available courses
activate browser
browser -> course_service: Requests course catalog
activate course_service
course_service --> browser: Returns course catalog
deactivate course_service
browser --> user: Displays course catalog
deactivate browser

user -> browser: Clicks "Enroll" (course ID)
activate browser
browser -> course_service: Requests enrollment (user ID, course ID)
activate course_service
course_service -> course_service: Verifies eligibility & enrollment status
alt Eligible and Not Already Enrolled
    course_service -> course_service: Enrolls user in course
    course_service -> course_service: Adds user to course roster
    course_service -> notification_service: Sends enrollment confirmation (user ID, course ID)
    activate notification_service
    notification_service --> course_service: Confirmation sent
    deactivate notification_service
    course_service --> browser: Returns enrollment success
    browser --> user: Displays enrollment confirmation
else Not Eligible or Already Enrolled
    course_service --> browser: Returns enrollment failure (reason)
    browser --> user: Displays error message (reason)
end
deactivate course_service
deactivate browser



@enduml
```

Generate Sequence Diagram
Content Consumption:

User accesses a course.
User views course materials (videos, documents, quizzes).
User interacts with the content (watches videos, reads documents, attempts quizzes).
System tracks user's progress and engagement.

```plantuml
@startuml

actor User as user
participant Browser as browser
participant "Content Service" as content_service
participant "Tracking Service" as tracking_service

user -> browser: Accesses course (course ID)
activate browser
browser -> content_service: Requests course content (user ID, course ID)
activate content_service
content_service --> browser: Returns course content (modules, materials)
deactivate content_service
browser --> user: Displays course content
deactivate browser

loop While user interacts with content
    user -> browser: Views/Interacts with content (material ID, action)
    activate browser
    browser -> content_service: Requests specific material (material ID)
```

Generate Class Diagram
User:

Features: Username, profile photo, bio, location, interests, privacy settings.
Operations: Create profile, Edit profile, Delete profile, Upload profile picture, Adjust privacy settings.
FriendRequest:

Properties: request sender, request receiver, request status.
Operations: submit the request, accept the request, reject the request.
Post:

Characteristics: content (text, image, video), sender, time, interaction (likes, comments, shares).
Operations: create post, edit post, delete post, interact with post.
Comment:

Properties: content, sender, date.
Operations: add comment, edit comment, delete comment.
Message:

Properties: content, sender, receiver, date.
Operations: sending a message, receiving a message, deleting a message.

Properties: notification type (friend request, like, comment, message), recipient, status (read or unread).
Operations: Send notification, change notification status.

```plantuml
@startuml
class User {
    - username : string
    - profilePhoto : Image
    - bio : string
    - location : string
    - interests : List<string>
    - privacySettings : PrivacySettings
    + createProfile()
    + editProfile()
    + deleteProfile()
    + uploadProfilePicture(image : Image)
    + adjustPrivacySettings(settings : PrivacySettings)
}

class FriendRequest {
    - sender : User
    - receiver : User
    - status : RequestStatus
    + submitRequest()
    + acceptRequest()
    + rejectRequest()
}

enum RequestStatus {
    PENDING
    ACCEPTED
    REJECTED
}

class Post {
    - content : Content
    - sender : User
    - timestamp : DateTime
    - likes : int
    - comments : List<Comment>
    - shares : int
    + createPost(content : Content)
    + editPost(content : Content)
    + deletePost()
    + likePost()
    + commentOnPost(comment : Comment)
    + sharePost()
}

class Content {
    - text : string
    - image : Image
    - video : Video
}


class Comment {
    - content : string
    - sender : User
    - timestamp : DateTime
    + addComment(post : Post, content : string)
    + editComment(content : string)
    + deleteComment(post : Post)
}

class Message {
    - content : string
    - sender : User
    - receiver : User
    - timestamp : DateTime
    + sendMessage(receiver : User, content : string)
    + receiveMessage()
    + deleteMessage()
}

class Notification {
    - type : NotificationType
    - recipient : User
    - status : NotificationStatus
    + sendNotification(recipient : User, type : NotificationType)
    + changeStatus(status : NotificationStatus)
}

enum NotificationType {
    FRIEND_REQUEST
    LIKE
    COMMENT
    MESSAGE
}

enum NotificationStatus {
    READ
    UNREAD
}
```

Generate Sequence Diagram
Create a user profile:

The user enters his personal details.
A User object is created and the data is stored in the database.
The UserProfile class interacts with the UserAuthentication class to validate user data.
Send a friend request:

The user sends a friend request to another user.
A FriendRequest object is created with the sender and receiver specified.
A notification is sent to the target user using the Notification object.
Post a new post:

User creates a new post.
A Post object is created and stored in the database.
The NewsFeed is updated for connected users using the FeedService object.
Interact with a post:

Another user likes or comments on the post.
The number of likes is updated or a new comment is added to the Post object.
A notification is sent to the share owner using the Notification object.
Send a private message:

The user sends a message to another user.
A Message object is created with the sender and receiver specified.
The message is delivered to the recipient using an instant messaging system.
Receiving notifications:

When an event such as a friend request, comment, or like occurs, a Notification object is created.
The notification status is updated in the receiver's UI.

```plantuml
@startuml

actor User as user
participant UserProfile as profile
participant UserAuthentication as auth
participant FriendRequest as friend_request
participant Notification as notification
participant Post as post
participant FeedService as feed_service
participant Comment as comment
participant Message as message
participant "Messaging System" as messaging_system

== Create User Profile ==

user -> profile: Enters profile details
activate profile
profile -> auth: Validates user data
activate auth
auth --> profile: Validation result
deactivate auth
profile -> system: Stores user data in database
profile --> user: Profile created
deactivate profile

== Send Friend Request ==

user -> friend_request: Sends friend request (target user)
activate friend_request
friend_request -> system: Stores request in database
friend_request -> notification: Send notification (target user)
activate notification
notification --> user: Notification sent
deactivate notification
friend_request --> user: Request sent
deactivate friend_request

== Post a New Post ==

user -> post: Creates new post (content)
activate post
post -> system: Stores post in database
post -> feed_service: Update news feeds (connected users)
activate feed_service
feed_service --> post: Feeds updated
deactivate feed_service
post --> user: Post created
deactivate post

== Interact with a Post ==

user -> post: Likes/Comments on post (post ID, action)
activate post
alt Like
    post -> system: Increments like count
else Comment
    user -> comment: Creates comment (content)
    activate comment
    comment -> system: Stores comment in database
    comment --> post: Comment created
    deactivate comment
    post -> system: Adds comment to post
end
post -> notification: Send notification (post owner)
activate notification
notification --> user: Notification sent
deactivate notification
post --> user: Interaction registered
deactivate post


== Send a Private Message ==

user -> message: Sends message (recipient, content)
activate message
message -> system: Stores message in database  'Optional, depending on if messages need to be persisted
message -> messaging_system: Delivers message (recipient, content)
activate messaging_system
messaging_system --> user: Message delivered
deactivate messaging_system
message --> user: Message sent
deactivate message


== Receiving Notifications ==

notification -> system: Retrieves notification details
notification --> user: Displays notification in UI


@enduml
```

User Interface (UI):

Display a preview of the generated report with placeholder diagrams. Allow users to review, modify, and approve the content.
Final Report Generation:

Compile the approved content and diagrams into a downloadable report in multiple formats (DOCX, PDF, Markdown).

Report Version Control:

Maintain versions of the report, allowing users to revert to previous versions if needed.
Feedback System:

Enable users to provide feedback on the generated content and diagrams.
